hints.title: Chunk Partitioning
hints.text: While the length of string s is strictly greater than k, divide s into consecutive groups of size k.

hints.title: Digit Sum Concatenation
hints.text: For each chunk, sum its constituent digits and convert the sum to a string.

hints.title: String Replacement
hints.text: Concatenate the string sums of all groups to form the new string s, and repeat until len(s) <= k.

hints.title: Iterative Chunk Reduction Implementation

complexity.notes: Each round reduces the length of s by approximately a factor of k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive or unbounded slicing without length check can cause infinite loop.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Intermediate chunk string buffer uses O(n) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements clean chunk iteration with sum concatenation.
